chapterInfo.content:
13
Wɔyi ananafoɔ firi Israel
1 # Deut 23.3-5 Ɛberɛ no ara mu na wɔkenkann Mose nwoma no mu, ɔman no aso mu, na wɔhunuu sɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ, Amonni ne Moabni mmma Nyankopɔn badwa mu da biara da, 2#Num 22.5-6 ɛfiri sɛ wɔamfa aduane ne nsuo ammɛhyia Israelfoɔ, na mmom wɔkɔbɔɔ Bileam paa tiaa wɔn sɛ ɔmmɛdome wɔn; nanso yɛn Nyankopɔn danee nnome no nhyira. 3Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔtee mmara no, wɔyiyii amamfrafoɔ nyinaa firii Israel.
Nehemia ntotoɔ adwuma
4Na yei nnya mmaeɛ no, na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eliasib a wɔde no sii yɛn Nyankopɔn fie mpia soɔ, a ɔyɛ Tobia busuani no 5asiesie pia kɛseɛ bi ama no, deɛ akane no na wɔde aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ ne ohwamfufuo ne nnwinneɛ ne ayuo ntotosoɔ du du ne nsa ne ngo a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma Lewifoɔ ne nnwontofoɔ ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no, ɛne asɔfoɔ no mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ no sie no. 6Na yei nyinaa mu no na menni Yerusalem, na Babelhene Artasasta afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa mmienu soɔ no, mekɔɔ ɔhene no nkyɛn. Na nna bi akyiri no, mebisaa ɔhene hɔ kwan, 7na mebaa Yerusalem; na mebɛhunuu bɔne a Eliasib yɛeɛ wɔ Tobia ho, sɛ wasiesie pia ama no Nyankopɔn fie abannwa soɔ no. 8Na me bo fuu kɛse, na meyiyii Tobia fie nnoɔma no nyinaa firii pia no mu gui, 9na mekaa sɛ wɔnnwira mpia no mu, na mede Nyankopɔn fie nnoɔma no mesane mebaa hɔ bio, aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ ne ohwamfufuo no.
10Na mehunuu sɛ Lewifoɔ kyɛfa no, wɔamfa amma wɔn, enti wɔadwanedwane kɔ wɔn mfuo mu, Lewifoɔ ne nnwontofoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma no. 11#Neh 10.39 Na me ne mmapɔmma no hamee, na mese: Adɛn nti na wɔagya Nyankopɔn fie yi? Na meboaboaa wɔn ano mede wɔn sisii wɔn diberɛ. 12#Num 18.21 Na Yuda nyinaa de ayuo ne nsa ne ngo ntotosoɔ du du ba bɛguu akoradeɛ no mu. 13Na mesisii akoradeɛ no so ahwɛfoɔ: Ɔsɔfoɔ Selemia, Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Sadok ne Pedaia a ɔfiri Lewifoɔ no mu no; na na wɔn ase na Sakur ba Matania ba Hanan hyɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔbu wɔn nokwafoɔ, na wɔn na na wɔkyekyɛ nnoɔma no ma wɔn nuanom no. 14#Neh 13.31; 5.19 Me Nyankopɔn, kae me yei ho, na mpepa m’adɔeɛ a mayɛ mama me Nyankopɔn fie ne ne som adwuma no.
Wɔfirii homeda ntotoeɛ ase
15 # Neh 10.31; Yer 17.21-27 Nna no mu na mehunuu Yudafoɔ bi a wɔtiatia nsa-kyi-amena soɔ homeda, na wɔde ayuo afiafi nso ba, na wɔde soasoa mfunumu; wɔde nsa nso ne bobe aba ne borɔdɔma ne nnesoa ahodoɔ nyinaa ba Yerusalem home da, na mebɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ da a wɔretɔn nnuane no. 16Na Tirofoɔ bi a wɔte kurom hɔ nso de mpataa ne adetɔnneɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa ba, na wɔbɛtɔn no home da ma Yuda mma ne Yerusalemfoɔ. 17Ɛnna me ne Yuda mmapɔmma no hameeɛ, na mesee wɔn sɛ: Asɛmmɔne bɛn na moredie de kum homeda ho yi? 18Ɛnyɛ saa na mo agyanom yɛeɛ, na yɛn Nyankopɔn de bɔne yi nyinaa baa yɛn ne kuro yi soɔ no? Na mo nso mode bi reka Israel so abufuo no ho, sɛ morekum home da ho yi.
19Na ansa na homeda reduro no, esum refiri aseɛ aduru Yerusalem apono mu no, mehyɛɛ sɛ wɔntoto apono no mu, na mekaa sɛ wɔnnhini gye sɛ homeda no atwam ansa; na meyii m’asomfoɔ no mu binom gyinagyinaa apono no ano, na adesoa bi amma mu homeda. 20Na adwadifoɔ ne adetɔnfoɔ ahodoɔ no tɔnfoɔ no soɛsoɛɛ Yerusalem apono no akyi prɛko ne mprenu. 21Ɛnna mebɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na moasoɛsoɛ, deda ɔfasuo no akyire? Sɛ moyɛ saa bio a, mɛkye mo. Ɛfiri saa berɛ no, wɔamma homeda bio. 22#Neh 13.14 Na mesee Lewifoɔ no sɛ wɔnnwira wɔn ho na wɔmmra mmɛhwɛ apono no ano, na wɔnyɛ home da no kronkron. Yei ho nso kae me, me Nyankopɔn, na kora me sɛdeɛ w’adɔeɛ bebree no teɛ.
23Nna no mu nso mehunuu Yudafoɔ a wɔawareware Asdod mmaa ne Amon mmaa ne Moab mmaa. 24Na wɔn mma ka Asdod kasa fa-ne-fa, na Yuda kasa deɛ, wɔntumi nka, na aman no mu bi deɛ na wɔka. 25#Deut 7.3 Na me ne wɔn hamee, na medomee wɔn, na mebobɔɔ mmarima no mu binom, na metutuu wɔn nwi, na mede Nyankopɔn ntam gyee wɔn sɛ: Sɛ mode mo mmammaa ma wɔn mmammarima, na mogye wɔn mmammaa mema mo mma awadeɛ anaasɛ mo ankasa moware wɔn a. 26#1 Ah 11.3-8 Ɛnyɛ yeinom ho na Israelhene Salomo yɛɛ bɔne? Nanso amanaman nyinaa mu hene biara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ ɔno, na onipa a Onyankopɔn dɔ no ne no, na Onyankopɔn de no sii Israel nyinaa so hene, ɔno mpo, mmaa ananafoɔ na wɔmaa no yɛɛ bɔne. 27Na mo deɛ, yɛntie mo sɛ yɛbɛyɛ bɔne kɛseɛ yi nyinaa na yɛafom yɛn Nyankopɔn na yɛaware mmaa ananafoɔ?
28 # Neh 11.10; 2.19 Na Ɔsɔfopanin Eliasib ba Yoiada mma mu baako ayɛ Horonni Sanbalat ase. Na mepamm no firii me ho. 29Kae wɔn, me Nyankopɔn, sɛ wɔagu asɔfodie ho ne asɔfodie ho mmara, ne asɔfodie ne Lewifoɔ apam no ho fi.
30Na medwiraa wɔn ho firii amanaman nnoɔma nyinaa ho, na mehyehyɛɛ asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no asɛdeɛ, sɛdeɛ obiara adwuma teɛ. 31#Neh 13.14, 22; 5.19 Mehyehyɛɛ berɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nnyina afɔrebɔ ne berɛ a wɔde nnuabakan deɛ ba. O me Nyankopɔn, kae me ma ɛnsi me yie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
